spans.s:
f. (-का)
The earth.
E.
इल to go, कन् and टाप् affixes.

f. (-ली)
A cudgel, a stick shaped like a sword or a short sword: see ईली.

f. (-ली)
A weapon, sometimes considered as a cudgel, and sometimes as a short sword, or a stick shaped like a sword.
E.
ईर to go, &c. क and ङीप् affixes, and र changed to ल; see इली; also ईलि, &c.

m. (-शः)
A fish, commonly the Hilsa or Sable, (Clupea alosa.)
E.
इल to go, (in the water,) and ईश chief, principal. The fish being one of high flavour, and very abundant at certain seasons, it is generally eaten both by the natives of Bengal, and by Europeans residing there.

m. (-शः)
The Hilsa fish: see इलीश; also ईल्लीश.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised.
E.
इड to praise, affix क्त, and ड changed to ल.
